text: 11月11日，上海市发展改革委、市交通委、市财政局联合印发《关于优化我市道路停车收费政策的通知》，将于2026年11月18日起正式施行，系2005年上海出台机动车管理实施意见以来首次对道路停车收费全面调整。新规明确：单台机动车辆在道路停车场单次停放15分钟（含）以内限次免收停车费，工作日每日限2次，周六、周日及全体公民放假日每日限3次；超过15分钟自入场起始时间起计费，短时免费停放不适用于按次计费的临时道路停车场。智慧道路停车场以15分钟为一个按时计费单位，人工收费道路停车场以30分钟为一个按时计费单位；白天时段按停放时长实行阶梯价格管理，夜间时段实行按
text_en: On November 11, the Shanghai Municipal Development and Reform Commission, the Municipal Transport Commission and the Municipal Finance Bureau jointly issued the Notice on Optimizing the City's Road Parking Charging Policy, which will officially take effect on November 18, 2026. It is the first comprehensive adjustment to road parking charges since Shanghai issued its implementation opinions on motor vehicle management in 2005. The new rules specify that a single motor vehicle may be exempt from parking fees for a limited number of single stays of 15 minutes or less at road parking lots, capped at 2 times per day on weekdays and 3 times per day on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays; charges for stays exceeding 15 minutes start from the entry time, and the short-term free parking does not apply to temporary road parking lots charged per session.
